Type: storage ottoman bench
Use: seating and storage; bedroom, living room, entryway; at the foot of a bed
Style: contemporary, classic, modern
Materials: faux leather upholstery, stitched panels, wood feet
Colors: dark brown cocoa, black
Shape: long rectangular box with lift-up tufted lid, vertical stitched panels, short square feet, low and bulky
Feel: cozy, solid, practical
Goes with: dark wood, cream bedding, warm neutrals; classic or contemporary bedrooms

product.name: Red Hook Meknes Rectangular Faux Leather Storage Ottoman Bench - Dark Cocoa
product.description: Large rectangular-shaped storage ottoman works well as a coffee table, footrest, or bench Hidden storage space inside—great for extra throw pillows, blankets, books, shoes, games, or other items Sturdy hinges, including child-safety hinges to ensure a slow, quiet, finger-safe closure (no slamming shut) Hand constructed using solid and engineered woods; faux-leather upholstery with beautiful stitching; traditional, sophisticated style Measures 48 by 17.7 by 16.4 inches; minimal assembly required (simply screw on the legs)
